summary: The study investigates the enhanced incorporation of Te and S impurities in GaAs through alternate doping using molecular layer epitaxy (MLE). The process involves intermittent injection of AsH3 and TEG, with Te and S dopants introduced via DETe and DES, respectively. The results show that the incorporation of Te is enhanced when S coverage is present, and the co-doping of Te and S improves crystal quality by reducing strain.
